item.title: What Is ‘Somatic Shaking,’ and Can It Really Reduce Stress?
item.description: People on social media say a few minutes of fast, energetic movement — jumping, arm flailing, foot stomping — can release tension. Does it really work?

item.title: What to Know About Glyphosate, the Weed Killer Potentially Linked to Cancer
item.description: Four out of 5 Americans over age 6 have measurable levels of glyphosate in their urine. Is this cause for concern as the U.S. boosts glyphosate production to make more of the herbicide Roundup?

item.title: Is Microdosing Ozempic or Other GLP-1s Effective for Weight Loss?
item.description: There’s no evidence yet that supports taking smaller doses of GLP-1s than recommended. Learn the risks of this approach to weight management.

item.title: What Is Parkinson’s Disease? Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prevention
item.description: Causes and symptoms of Parkinson’s disease can vary from person to person. While there is no cure, medications and treatments can help.

item.title: How to Prep Your Body for Turning the Clocks Ahead for Daylight Saving Time
item.description: Before we turn the clocks ahead this spring, here’s what you can do to make the transition easier on your sleep, wake-up, and eating schedules.

item.title: Bronchiectasis Treatment: Medication, Airway Clearance, Lifestyle Changes, and More
item.description: Learn how to manage bronchiectasis through airway clearance, the latest medications like brensocatib, and lifestyle changes to avoid infections and breathe easier.

item.title: Can You Get Pregnant After Menopause?
item.description: Learn how menopause affects fertility and the chances of pregnancy via IVF. Explore postmenopause IVF risks so you can make informed health choices.

item.title: 11 Benefits of Taking a Break From Alcohol
item.description: Discover alcohol-free benefits including better mental health, improved relationships, reduced cardiovascular risk, and greater digestive health.

item.title: What Are the Different Types of Saturated Fat, and Are Some Healthier Than Others?
item.description: Not all saturated fats are identical or affect the body in the same way. Learn about the different kinds and their impacts on cholesterol and heart health.

item.title: 4 Reasons Pooping Feels Good
item.description: Find out why bowel movements, a routine bodily function, can feel satisfying — or even euphoric — at times. Experts reveal why defecation can bring a sense of relief.
